Apple Event September 2022: iPhone 14 Pro summary slide

The dark version of Apple’s summary grid for iPhone 14 Pro, with a large product tile in the middle and violet gradient type.

Source
Apple Summary Slides (fan archive): Apple Event September 2022

Evidence
Inspected the 1920 × 1080 WebP [Apple Event September 2022]-[iPhone]-[iPhone 14 Pro].webp from the fan archive Apple Summary Slides (Ricky Zhang), which says that all images are screenshots of Apple event videos. The copy is a frame of the event video, not an Apple press file. Not stored.

Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

Apple introduced iPhone 14 Pro at its event on 7 September 2022. Deck.gallery lists the Apple Event Product Summary 2022 among four Apple bento decks (Deck.gallery).

Observed

  • The ground is black and the tiles are a slightly lighter near-black, with large rounded corners and narrow even gutters.
  • About twenty tiles of different sizes fill the frame. The largest tile, in the center, shows the top of a deep purple iPhone 14 Pro with its camera, cropped by the tile edge.
  • Several key words are set large in bold type filled with a violet or blue gradient: “ProMotion”, “Always-On display”, “Ultra Wide”, “48MP”, “Action mode”.
  • Smaller tiles carry white labels with one image each: a green battery ring, a MagSafe charger, four phone colors, an A16 Bionic chip.
  • Numbers appear as large blue headings with white labels: “1600 nits”, “2000 nits”.

Why it belongs

The dark slide shows that the look is not a color scheme. What stays the same as the light slides is the rounded tonal tile, the narrow gutter, the mixed sizes, and the one-fact-per-tile rule.

Borrow

On a dark ground, use tiles only a few steps lighter than the ground and keep color for the type and the product.

Fill the key word of a tile with the product color as a gradient.
